title: Alsona
lede: Alsona watches for signs that a company is ready to buy, scores those companies against your ideal customer profile, and has AI agents write and send LinkedIn and email outreach while the window is open.

points: You paste in your website, and Alsona drafts an ideal customer profile and pitch from it in about half a minute.
It tracks more than 32 signal sources in nine categories, including hiring, funding, tech-stack changes, review activity and ad spend.
Less common signals include procurement notices, website changes and mentions on podcasts, which the team says matter most outside tech.
Each flagged company comes with the evidence behind its score, and you can export the list or let the agent run outreach and book meetings.
Outreach rotates across several LinkedIn and email senders, with one shared inbox for replies.

sections.text: Founders and sales people who run their own outbound, and agencies running outreach for several clients, including under their own brand.
Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, and the launch comment offers 30% off for three months.
